title: Vibrant Smoky Canadian Lamb Skewers
description: A spicy and indulgent Canadian dish featuring smoky lamb, chives, and a macrobiotic-friendly blend of ingredients, perfect for a dinner party. This recipe combines the richness of lamb with the freshness of chives and the depth of smoky flavors.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and lemon juice.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, mix the chopped chives with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Once the lamb is cooked, remove from the grill and sprinkle with the chive mixture.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional chives if desired.
